BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring public employers under chapter 41.80 RCW to provide employee information to exclusive bargaining representatives.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring public employers under chapter 41.80 RCW to provide employee information to exclusive bargaining representatives; and amending RCW 41.80.075.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 41.80.075 and 2023 c 204 s 4 are each amended to read as follows:Information to be provided to exclusive bargaining representative by certain employers.
